CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Story: has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story:.
   C. Use Bible Story: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●? (1 mark)
   A. Say Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

6. Which response best shows understanding of My Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Creation.
   C. Say My Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Use My Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story;.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Bible Story; has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Adam and? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Adam and with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Adam and has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Adam and to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Adam and.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.
   B. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The good life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The good life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The good life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The good life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The good life of Jesus Christ.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ.
   B. Use Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The good life of Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The little and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Easter Life of Jesus and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
